title: Following Jesus as Your Lord
description: A lesson on surrendering to Jesus as Lord and learning to prioritize Him above all things.

cards.heading: Sharing Your Walk with God
cards.scriptureText: Commit your way to the Lord; trust in him and he will do this.
cards.body: Share what you have experienced with the Lord during the past week. Encourage your disciple to share what they have learned through their Bible reading, especially from the Gospel of Mark.
cards.question: What has God been teaching you this week?

cards.heading: Reviewing God’s Word
cards.scriptureText: Those who live should no longer live for themselves but for him who died for them.
cards.body: Review previously learned verses together. These remind us that our lives now belong to Christ and should be lived for Him.
cards.question: What does it mean to live for Christ instead of yourself?

cards.heading: Jesus Christ Is Lord
cards.scriptureText: If you declare with your mouth, 'Jesus is Lord,' and believe in your heart... you will be saved.
cards.body: Jesus is not only Savior but also Lord. This means He has authority over our lives, and we choose to follow and obey Him.
cards.question: What does it mean for Jesus to be Lord of your life?

cards.heading: Choosing Jesus Above All
cards.scriptureText: Whoever does not... put me first cannot be my disciple.
cards.body: We all have things we value, people, goals, possessions, and desires. Following Jesus means choosing Him above everything else and making Him our highest priority.
cards.question: What things in your life compete with Jesus for first place?

cards.heading: Putting Jesus First
cards.scriptureText: Seek first his kingdom and his righteousness.
cards.body: God does not take away what we have, but He wants to be first in our lives. When Jesus is Lord, everything else falls into the right place.
cards.question: How can you practically put Jesus first in your daily life?

cards.heading: Surrender Is a Daily Process
cards.scriptureText: Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross daily and follow me.
cards.body: Surrendering to Jesus is not a one-time decision but a daily choice. Every day, we choose to follow Him and trust His leadership.
cards.question: What area of your life is hardest to surrender to Jesus?

cards.heading: Obedience Through Baptism
cards.scriptureText: Go and make disciples... baptizing them.
cards.body: One of the first steps of obedience is baptism. It is a public declaration that you belong to Jesus and are following Him.
cards.question: Have you taken the step of baptism? If not, what is holding you back?

cards.heading: Honoring God Through Giving
cards.scriptureText: Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse.
cards.body: Giving is a way of honoring God and recognizing that everything we have comes from Him. It reflects trust and surrender in our lives.
cards.question: How does giving show that Jesus is Lord of your life?

cards.heading: Living Under His Lordship
cards.scriptureText: Whatever you do... do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus.
cards.body: When Jesus is Lord, every part of life, decisions, relationships, and actions, is surrendered to Him.
cards.question: What is one decision you need to surrender to Jesus today?

cards.heading: Next Steps
cards.scriptureText: We brought nothing into the world, and we can take nothing out of it.
cards.body: Set your next meeting and continue learning to surrender your life to Jesus. Trust Him with everything you have and everything you are.
cards.question: What step will you take this week to follow Jesus more fully?
